engine.name: Webfoot custom tracker driver (not MP2K)
engine.output: stereo, DMA A = left, DMA B = right, 8-bit
engine.sfx_policy: first free voice of 16, otherwise the request is dropped; no priority, no per-sound limit; volume 0..64, pan s8

render.loop_note: loop.start/loop.end in seconds of the file; the loop is periodic from start, so jumping end->start is seamless even with a few ms of decoder offset
